I wrote `docs/upgrade/README.md` as the full manifest authoring guide — the machine-contract framing, when a release needs an entry, the complete per-action field set (kind/severity/detail/commands/introduced_commands/applies_when/status_probe/success_message/failure_message/human_next_step/docs_url/evidence_uri) with the required-action invariants, `show_on_first_run` + first-run policy, how to add a fail-closed status_probe vs fail-open applies_when predicate, the baseline scope (D018/D039), and the no-mutation v0 boundary (D007/D028). I linked `CHANGELOG.md` to `docs/upgrade/releases.json` (new "Relationship to releases.json" section) and added the dated `2026-06-22` entry for the doctor up
